User Request: Show me our best customers.

Dashboard Components:
Title: Top Customers by Revenue
Type: table
Description: List of top customers based on total revenue generated
Title: Customer Segmentation
Type: pie_chart
Description: Distribution of customers by type
Title: Customer Order Trends
Type: line_chart
Description: Trends in orders placed by top customers over time
Title: Average Order Value by Customer
Type: bar_chart
Description: Average order value for top customers

sql_queries.title: Top Customers by Revenue
sql_queries.description: List of top customers based on total revenue generated
sql_queries.sql: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 10

sql_queries.title: Customer Segmentation
sql_queries.sql: SELECT cd.CustomerDesc, COUNT(ccd.CustomerID) AS CustomerCount FROM CustomerDemographics cd JOIN CustomerCustomerDemo ccd ON cd.CustomerTypeID = ccd.CustomerTypeID GROUP BY cd.CustomerDesc

sql_queries.title: Customer Order Trends
sql_queries.description: Trends in orders placed by top customers over time
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, COUNT(o.OrderID) AS OrderCount FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID GROUP BY OrderMonth, c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName ORDER BY OrderMonth

sql_queries.title: Average Order Value by Customer
sql_queries.description: Average order value for top customers
sql_queries.sql: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, AVG(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS AverageOrderValue FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName ORDER BY AverageOrderValue DESC LIMIT 10
